{{Top|leg}}
'''Maltorran protoplasm''' was a type of substance.

==History==
In [[671 BBY]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kossak the Younger]] condemned the playwright [[Direus'pei]] and all copies of his play [[Evocar (play)|''Evocar'']] to be engorged by Maltorran protoplasm.
